# Client 340K to 1.3M

> [!note] Test fixture. A planned (unpublished) video, framed for the vid-title eval. Built on Billy's real proof ([[proof-bank/business-owner-340k-to-1-3m]]). Not a published claim.

## Locked angle (from vid-framing)

A business owner with a 2,500-subscriber channel went from $340K to $1.3M in revenue in one year. Not by growing the audience (it stayed small, a couple hundred views per video) but by building the content system that turned a small, right audience into buyers. The contrarian hook: you do not need a big audience, you need the right people plus the system that converts them.
